Class MenuItem

java.lang.Object
restaurant.model.MenuItem
Direct Known Subclasses:
DessertItem, DrinkItem, FoodItem
public abstract class MenuItem extends Object
Abstract superclass representing a general restaurant menu item. Specific menu item types extend this class.

      public MenuItem(int itemId, String name, double basePrice)
      Creates a menu item with an ID, name, and base price.
      Parameters:
      itemId - the positive ID of the item
      name - the name of the item
      basePrice - the non-negative base price
